scope: AG2F90-D correction, embodiment registry, frozen public pilot, Isaac Lab preflight, and strict real blind-review evidence
summary: PhiAgent-Bench now targets the company's CTAG2F90-D, pins six representative arm sources without vendoring them, freezes three public L1 cases, and enforces protocol-bound real evidence; this host cannot execute RoboWM because the Isaac/GPU runtime is absent.
evidence: The CTAG2F90-D manifest records 0.8 kg mass, 90 mm stroke, 25 N force, 100/250 mm/s declared modes, position/speed/force feedback, and keeps the 250 mm/s mode confirmation-gated; adapter compatibility passes while execution_enabled remains false.

The embodiment registry validates eight unique assets: six pinned official arm repositories and two ChangingTek end-effector metadata entries; none is overstated as simulation-validated or hardware-validated.

The frozen public visual pilot verifies all three repository artifacts by exact size and SHA-256 and parses three L1-only cases spanning rigid rearrangement, deformable configuration, and surface transformation.
A valid L5 result now requires the case's declared protocol, pre-registration, reviewer SHA-256, and the complete eight-artifact hash set in addition to blind success and safety gates.

Twenty focused benchmark and evidence tests pass. The full CPU suite reports 961 passed, 3 skipped, and the same 2 unrelated existing JoyAI failures caused by missing ffmpeg/ffprobe and a timeout-argument mismatch.
The RoboWM source revision preflight passes, but runtime status is not_ready because this host has Python 3.13 rather than 3.11 and lacks torch, Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and a visible NVIDIA GPU.
lessons: Broad hardware coverage should be a tiered source registry and validation campaign, not an unreviewed dump of URDF files.
A visually interchangeable gripper model can still change payload, speed, timing, controller, and safety constraints; visual compatibility does not imply dynamic equivalence.
Public uncalibrated videos can freeze L1 reproducibly but cannot supply L2 geometry, L3 action, L4 physics, or L5 real labels.
Blind review must be pre-registered and hash-bound in code, not asserted by one unchecked boolean.
limitations: The CTAG2F90-D official digital model is not redistributed and its marked 250 mm/s operating conditions still require manufacturer or installed-firmware confirmation.
The six pinned arm sources have not yet completed independent FK, collision, inertia, controller, and simulator cross-checks.
No RoboWM Isaac Lab episode ran on this host and no new physical RM65/AG2F90-D blind trial was executed.
The public pilot covers three of six H2R task families and is intentionally visual-only.
next_actions: Run the pinned RoboWM pilot in an isolated Python 3.11, PyTorch 2.7 CUDA 12.8, Isaac Sim 5.1 environment on an NVIDIA GPU and import full PhiAgent L4 gates.
Promote RM65-B and CTAG2F90-D through kinematic, simulation, then hardware validation using official geometry and measured installed-firmware limits.
Collect at least ten pre-registered trials per case and embodiment across three independent sessions with operator/reviewer separation.
